name: Magehold Fairwinds
storyline: You captain the Tallow Hen, a patched-up cargo airship that still owes the Carriers' Guild 120 silver. Her voyage crosses five acts and nine regions of Magehold: river docks, crystal cliffs, beastborn aeries, gnome clock-cities, the lawless Reaches and the great houses of the Crown Peak. At the far end lies the Hush Front, where the magic is draining out of the world. Captains who survive the journey can pay off the debt, or keep the ship and run.
summary: Magehold Fairwinds is a roguelite airship strategy game set in the world of Magehold. Players captain a leaking cargo airship across five acts and nine regions, fighting real-time-with-pause battles room by room: routing Flow between ship systems, targeting enemy rooms with 18 ship weapons, casting 30 spells, raising wind shields and boarding enemy vessels. Between battles, players take parties of up to four on dungeon delves, recruit and manage a crew who form bonds and gain skills, and make choices in more than 480 events. Features include 11 unlockable airships with a refit yard, 58 fittings, nine boss encounters, seeded voyages and a Daily Charter, multiple difficulty settings, an optional Auto Battle mode and three endings.
